rationale: Optimal dispatch minimizes diesel fuel cost by using available PV in periods t1 and t2, and maximally discharging the battery in period t3 when PV is abundant. The battery remains at 18 MWh (within limits) during t1-t2, then discharges to exactly soc_min=6.0 MWh in t3, utilizing all available discharge capacity to reduce expensive diesel generation.
